author: hani
abstract: Holistic UX design intelligence for building clean, usable UI artifacts. Organizes 48 atomic rules into 7 pillars — Foundations, Layout & Hierarchy, Visual Design, Interaction & Motion, Navigation & IA, Content & Microcopy, and Accessibility & Inclusion — applied through a build workflow that turns intent into a clean artifact. The 23 Memorisely-derived additions record direct reel provenance.
